100451.title: Front wheel component relationships
guidance: Check the supplied 1 EA HL Hub (Product Number HU-8998) and 1 EA ML Mountain Rim (Product Number RM-M692) for visible damage before assembly.

Arrange 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283) and 36 EA LL Nipple (Product Number NI-4127) with the hub and rim. Use the applicable component guidance for the lacing pattern; illustration 100451 shows the component relationships only.

Fit 1 EA Mountain Tire Tube (Product Number TT-M928) inside 1 EA ML Mountain Tire (Product Number TI-M602) and fit them to the rim, taking care not to pinch the tube. Follow component guidance for seating and inflation.
Fit 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) using the applicable supplied mounting guidance; the mounting details are not specified in the snapshot.
